arxiv-1810-09420.title: LHC Dark Matter Working Group: Next-generation spin-0 dark matter models
arxiv-1810-09420.creator: and Chen Zhou
arxiv-1810-09420.description: Abstract Dark matter (DM) simplified models are by now commonly used by the ATLAS and CMS Collaborations to interpret searches for missing transverse energy ( E T miss E_{T}^{\mathrm{miss}} ). The coherent use of these models sharpened the LHC DM search program, especially in the presentation of its results and their comparison to DM direct-detection (DD) and indirect-detection (ID) experiments.

arxiv-2105-10723.creator: ChangQing Xu, Yi Liu, XinFang Liao, JiaLiang Cheng, YinTang Yang
arxiv-2105-10723.description: Abstract In this paper, a novel machine learning regression based single event transient (SET) modeling method is proposed. The proposed method can obtain a reasonable and accurate model without considering the complex physical mechanism. We got plenty of SET current data of SMIC 130nm bulk CMOS by TCAD simulation under different conditions (e.g. different LET and different drain bias voltage).

The 40m radiotelescope at Yebes Observatory is operated by the Spanish Geographic Institute (IGN, Minister
arxiv-2110-15890.creator: C. Cabezas, M. Nakajima, C. H. Chang, M. Agúndez, Y. Endo, and J. Cernicharo
arxiv-2110-15890.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by C. Cabezas, M. Nakajima, C. H. Chang, M. Agúndez, Y. Endo, and J. Cernicharo. The reaction between carbon atoms and vinyl cyanide, CH 2 CHCN, is a formation route to interstellar 3-cyano propargyl radical, CH 2 C 3 N, a species that has recently been discovered in space. The 1-cyano propargyl radical (HC 3 HCN), an isomer of CH 2 C 3 N, is predicted to be produced in the same reaction at least twice more efficiently than CH 2 C 3 N.

arxiv-2207-06992.title: Limit sets of unfolding paths in Outer space
arxiv-2207-06992.creator: Mladen Bestvina, Radhika Gupta, Jing Tao
arxiv-2207-06992.description: Abstract We construct an unfolding path in Outer space which does not converge in the boundary, and instead it accumulates on the entire 1-simplex of projectivized length measures on a non-geometric arational ℝ {\mathbb{R}} -tree T T . We also show that T T admits exactly two dual ergodic projective currents.

arxiv-2310-18583.title: Self-Supervised Multi-Modality Learning for Multi-Label Skin Lesion Classification
arxiv-2310-18583.creator: Hao Wang, Euijoon Ahn, Lei Bi, Jinman Kim
arxiv-2310-18583.description: Abstract The clinical diagnosis of skin lesion involves the analysis of dermoscopic and clinical modalities. Dermoscopic images provide a detailed view of the surface structures whereas clinical images offer a complementary macroscopic information. The visual diagnosis of melanoma is also based on seven-point checklist which involves identifying different visual attributes.

arxiv-2405-07977.title: A Demographic-Conditioned Variational Autoencoder for fMRI Distribution Sampling and Removal of Confounds
arxiv-2405-07977.creator: Anton Orlichenko, Gang Qu, Ziyu Zhou, Anqi Liu, Hong-Wen Deng, Zhengming Ding, Julia M. Stephen, Tony W. Wilson, Vince D. Calhoun, Yu-Ping Wang
arxiv-2405-07977.description: Abstract Objective: fMRI and derived measures such as functional connectivity (FC) have been used to predict brain age, general fluid intelligence, psychiatric disease status, and preclinical neurodegenerative disease. However, it is not always clear that all demographic confounds, such as age, sex, and race, have been removed from fMRI data.

arxiv-2502-03229.title: A Unified Framework for Semi-Supervised Image Segmentation and Registration
arxiv-2502-03229.creator: Ruizhe Li, Grazziela Figueredo, Dorothee Auer, Rob Dineen, Paul Morgan, Xin Chen
arxiv-2502-03229.description: Abstract Semi-supervised learning, which leverages both annotated and unannotated data, is an efficient approach for medical image segmentation, where obtaining annotations for the whole dataset is time-consuming and costly. Traditional semi-supervised methods primarily focus on extracting features and learning data distributions from unannotated data to enhance model training.

We calculate the algebraic structure of real K \displaystyle K -theory and united K \displaystyle K -theory for all d \displaystyle d , we write down explicit unitaries representing the generators of all the non-trivial K \displaystyle K -theory groups for d ≤ 4 \displaystyle d\leq 4 , and we describe a recipe for generating such unitaries

arxiv-2510-02326.title: Hallucination-Resistant, Domain-Specific Research Assistant with Self-Evaluation and Vector-Grounded Retrieval
arxiv-2510-02326.creator: Vivek Bhavsar, Joseph Ereifej, Aravanan Gurusami
arxiv-2510-02326.description: Abstract Large language models accelerate literature synthesis but can hallucinate and mis-cite, limiting their usefulness in expert workflows. We present RA–FSM (Research Assistant – Finite State Machine), a modular, GPT-based research assistant that wraps generation in a finite-state control loop— Relevance → \rightarrow Confidence → \rightarrow Knowledge —grounded in vector retrieval and a deterministic citation pipeline.

arxiv-2510-17548.title: When Annotators Disagree, Topology Explains: Mapper, a Topological Tool for Exploring Text Embedding Geometry and Ambiguity
arxiv-2510-17548.creator: Nisrine Rair, Alban Goupil, Valeriu Vrabie, Emmanuel Chochoy
arxiv-2510-17548.description: Abstract Language models are often evaluated with scalar metrics like accuracy, but such measures fail to capture how models internally represent ambiguity, especially when human annotators disagree. We propose a topological perspective to analyze how fine-tuned models encode ambiguity and more generally instances.

pmc-10558180.creator: Peng Chen, Matthew L. Scarpelli, Debbie R. Healey, Shwetal Mehta, C. Chad Quarles
pmc-10558180.description: Background[18F]fluciclovine amino acid PET has shown promise for detecting brain tumor regions undetected on conventional anatomic MRI scans. However, it remains unclear which of these modalities provides a better assessment of the whole brain tumor burden. This study quantifies the performance of [18F]fluciclovine PET and MRI for detecting the whole brain tumor burden.

pmc-11428062.creator: Pejman Rohani, Elma Izze da Silva Magalhães, Roya Imanifard, Maryam Jarahzadeh, Fateme Ziamanesh, Somaye Fatahi, Hajar Ghorbani Jalalieh, Mohammad Hassan Sohouli
pmc-11428062.description: A gluten-free diet (GFD) may have a stronger potential impact on reducing cardiovascular (CV) risk factors, according to research evidence. We investigated the impact of GFD on CV risk variables by doing a systematic review and meta-analysis for this reason. We conducted a thorough database search starting on January 1, 2000, and ending on July 12, 2022.

pmc-13431390.creator: Siqi Guo
pmc-13431390.description: Nanosecond electric pulses (nsEPs) are an emerging pulsed-power technology with unique bioelectric characteristics distinct from conventional long-pulse electroporation. As a tunable physical modality, nsEPs can modulate intracellular structures, membrane dynamics, and signaling pathways. Increasing evidence supports nsEPs as a promising non-thermal tumor ablation approach due to their high spatial precision, preservation of critical tissue structures, and minimal adverse effects.
